original.name: Teferi, Hero of Dominaria
rules: +1: Draw a card. At the beginning of the next end step, untap up to two lands.

-8: You get an emblem with "Whenever you draw a card, exile target permanent an opponent controls."

rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
